memory_bridge: On ハチ is the regular compound reading; Kun 八つ（やっつ）is the complete native counter word for eight things.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 八月（はちがつ）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: Eight eggs hatch under the August calendar page; hatch → ハチ in 八月（はちがつ）.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 八つ（やっつ）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: Divide eight counters into two groups of four, then count the full native set: 八つ（やっつ）, ‘eight things.’
